pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal regions with sharply serrated edge gradients; spatial area is maximal on the mid-flank, decreasing towards the ventral and neck boundaries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pathways with consistent pixel width and distinct tri-point and quad-point junction nodes forming a cohesive topological graph.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D contour visible along the neck and upper shoulder ridge.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: Structural interruptions in the mane line at the mid-neck and shoulder junction.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple avian organisms perched along the dorsal ridge, causing localized occlusion of the mane and upper hide.
